Dificid (fidaxomicin) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline

Guideline Name 
Dificid (fidaxomicin)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Brand Dificid tablets, generic fidaxomicin tablets, Dificid suspension  
Approval Length 
10 Day(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile-associated diarrhea (CDAD) [previously known as 
Clostridium difficile- associated diarrhea]  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 453 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines

2 - BOTH of the following:  
 
 2.1 ONE of the following:  
 
  2.1.1 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to generic vancomycin oral solution  
 
OR 
 
  2.1.2 For continuation of prior therapy  
 
AND 
 
 2.2 If the request is for generic fidaxomicin tablets or Dificid suspension, trial and failure or 
intolerance to Brand Dificid tablets
